description: Independent adoption lifecycle for argument chains over the shared pool.
name: chain_lifecycle

states.description: Being assembled; steps and order not yet settled.
states.label: Draft

states.description: Put forward for adoption into the argument.
states.label: Proposed

states.description: Not adopted; does not render into the argument.
states.label: Declined

states.description: Replaced by a ratified successor chain.
states.label: Superseded

transitions.description: Put the chain forward for adoption. Actor: any author.
transitions.name: propose

transitions.description: Actor: THE OWNER ONLY. Adopting a chain into the argument is the act that cannot be delegated; an agent may propose, never adopt.
transitions.name: adopt

transitions.description: Actor: THE OWNER ONLY. Declining a chain is the same non-delegable act as adopting it, in the other direction.
transitions.name: decline

transitions.description: Replace with a successor chain; requires an incoming supersedes relation. Actor: any author.
transitions.name: supersede
